purpose: Test whether the literal repeat-positive p99/QPS rule attributes regressions when product, harness, binary, fixture, and configuration are identical in every ABBA leg.
repetition_order: A1 -> B1 -> B2 -> A2; every leg executes the identical binary and configuration.
disposition: The literal sign-only p99 gate and >10% two-pair QPS rule report regressions with identical product bytes. No product optimization can make this acceptance rule reliably attributable; #4288 remains blocked pending a prospectively specified noise/statistical contract.
